title: Semiorthogonal decompositions and components of derived categories of orthogonal Grassmannian fibrations
summary: Kuznetsov showed that for a flat quadric fibration $\mathcal{Q}$ over a smooth base $S$, $\mathrm{D}^b(\mathcal{Q})$ admits a semiorthogonal decomposition where one of the components is the derived category of the sheaf of even parts of a Clifford algebra $\mathrm{D}^b(S,\mathcal{C}l_0)$. \par As progress towards a generalization, we show that for a quadric fibration with a fairly minor condition on the rank of the quadric fibers, the category $\mathrm{D}^b(S,\mathcal{C}l_0)$ embeds fully faithfully into the derived category of the relative orthogonal Grassmannian…
